issue.title: Render SVG image embeds as fitted vector PDFs in note imports

task_type_fields.proposal: Proposed by bob-cli-8y.4 note #4. Design safe offline SVG-to-PDF rendering using the existing adapter batch infrastructure where appropriate, then feed vector PDFs into the snapshot pipeline. Evidence: docs/highlights-create.md explicitly documents SVG placeholders; note_snapshot/assets.rs process_image returns no result for AssetMediaKind::Svg and tests assert that behavior. Preserve visible per-image fallback, no network, scratch lifetime, and selectable/static text when SVG contains text. Define the protocol extension and font behavior before implementation.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Mermaid epic bob-cli-8y A10 explicitly excludes SVG image embeds; existing snapshot behavior documents them as unsupported. This is not caused by the Mermaid implementation and is distinct from bob-cli-85 web-article variable-font quote corruption.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-8y.4 note #4 proposes using the offline adapter for SVG embeds. Current snapshot assets intentionally replace SVG with Image not printable, so this is a separate capability.

payload.description: Related PDF rendering context; different scope, see task description
